title: dkNET Webinar: Building Knowledge Graphs Towards Transparent Biomedical AI with Dr. Jie Liu
bodyHtml: On 3/14/25, Dr. Jie Liu of the University of Michigan presented at the dkNET Webinar series. His talk was entitled, "Building Knowledge Graphs Towards Transparent Biomedical AI" and introduced knowledge graphs including the Genomic Knowledge Base, Genomic Literature Knowledge Base, and PanKgraph from Pankbase. The recording will soon be available on the dkNET YouTube Channel.
summary: Check out the March dkNET Webinar, entitled, "Building Knowledge Graphs Towards Transparent Biomedical AI" with Dr. Jie Liu. See the news page for more details about this exciting webinar!
